title: BSON document structure
summary: BSON (Binary JSON) documents are a sequence of typed elements followed by a null terminator. Each element: 1-byte type code, NUL-terminated field name (cstring), then the value (encoding depends on type). The document is prefixed by a 4-byte little-endian total size (including itself and the terminator).

structure.meaning: Total size of the document in bytes, including this field and the trailing 0x00. Little-endian.
1-byte type + cstring field name + value (type-specific encoding).

ext.example_decoded: Document {"name": "John"}: size 22, type 0x02 string, field 'name', value 'John'
notes: Type codes: 0x01 double, 0x02 string (int32 length + UTF-8 + NUL), 0x03 document, 0x04 array, 0x05 binary (subtype + int32 length + bytes), 0x06 undefined (deprecated), 0x07 ObjectId (12 bytes), 0x08 bool (1 byte), 0x09 datetime (int64 ms), 0x0A null, 0x0B regex (cstring pattern + cstring options), 0x0D JavaScript code, 0x10 int32, 0x12 int64, 0x13 decimal128.
Max document size is 16 MiB (MongoDB limit).
Field names must not contain '.' or start with '$' (MongoDB restriction).
Binary subtype 0x04 is UUID (old), subtype 0x03 is UUID (new, RFC 4122).
